generic_domain.justification: Mixed-Integer Programming (MIP) is the most generic and comprehensive domain among the provided research domains. It encompasses Linear Programming as a special case because when all variables in MIP are continuous, it reduces to Linear Programming. Additionally, 'linear-program' and 'linear programming' refer to similar concepts but with slightly different notations or focuses (e.g., one might emphasize the application vs. the method itself). Thus, MIP covers both LP and variations of linear programs by introducing integer variables, which adds more flexibility and generality.
